priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore socket listener removal
findings.body: The returned disposer no longer unregisters the message handler, so callbacks continue after teardown and repeated attachment accumulates duplicate listeners and retained references.

findings.title: [P2] Clear the polling interval on disposal
findings.body: The returned disposer leaves the interval active, so refresh continues after teardown, retained resources leak, and the interval can keep a Node process alive indefinitely.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns an empty disposer after line 2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler); the full PR diff shows this PR removed socket.off("message", handler).
